review.delivery: Attached actual local images through codex; per-image visual findings in host response; receipt 8b56bf0d-08b3-4001-89f1-c1fbaa74662c
review.judgment:
All ten supplied images were visually inspected. No visible clipping, text collisions, or serious contrast failures. Typography, imagery, and theme changes establish clear hierarchy and varied story rhythm. The desktop process scene is the weakest page: its connector routing makes a simple sequence unnecessarily difficult to follow.
capture-1-1440.png: All six scenes are visible. Chapter, image, metric, chart, table, and process compositions provide varied rhythm. No apparent clipping; process connectors are less clear than the other visual elements.
capture-1-390.png: All six scenes reflow into readable single columns without visible horizontal overflow. The comparison table remains contained; the vertical process sequence reads more clearly than its desktop counterpart.
capture-1-mobile-scene-4.png: Evidence scene: title, chart, legend, disclosure, explanation, and citation remain visible. Chart labels are compact but distinguishable, with strong contrast and no visible collisions.
capture-1-mobile-scene-6.png: Process scene: centered vertical nodes and downward arrows establish an unambiguous sequence. Heading, supporting text, and citation fit without clipping or overlap.
capture-1-scene-1.png: Chapter scene: white text contrasts strongly with violet. The divider separates title and body cleanly; generous empty space supports the intended pause.
capture-1-scene-2.png: Violet scene: the workbench image balances the large heading and supporting copy. Image caption is contained and legible; no text overlaps the artwork.
capture-1-scene-3.png: Collage scene: oversized metric and serif heading create a clear two-column hierarchy. Body, note, and citation have adequate separation and dark-on-cream contrast.
capture-1-scene-4.png: Evidence scene: both series, numeric labels, axes, and legend are distinguishable against black. Explanatory copy occupies a separate column without intruding into the chart.
capture-1-scene-5.png: Comparison scene: prominent heading leads into an aligned, readable three-column table. Header contrast is strong; rows, explanatory copy, and citation are visibly separated.
capture-1-scene-6.png: Process scene: text and nodes are legible and unclipped. This is the weakest page because long connectors enter destination nodes from below and crowd the area beneath Compare, slowing left-to-right reading.

issues.reason: In capture-1-scene-6.png, the horizontal sequence uses downward detours and upward arrowheads into destination bottoms. The adjacent incoming and outgoing routes beneath Compare make the simple Draft → Compare → Review progression harder to trace.
issues.suggestion: Connect each node's right edge directly to the next node's left edge with right-pointing arrows, retaining the clear vertical routing on mobile.

review.delivery: Attached actual local images through codex; per-image visual findings in host response; receipt 8c4e668d-9fac-4272-a3e2-f4ec661cf8b1
review.judgment:
All ten images were visually inspected. No visible clipping, text overlap, or contrast failure. Desktop and mobile layouts preserve readable hierarchy. The weakest page is comparison: its table offers little substantive contrast. Desktop process connectors also need clearer routing. This judgment covers supplied screenshots only; no tests or application checks ran.
capture-2-1440.png: All six scenes are visible. Violet opening, photographic scene, cream metric, and dark chart establish varied story rhythm. No apparent clipping; comparison is the weakest narrative beat, and desktop process connectors are unnecessarily indirect.
capture-2-390.png: All six scenes reflow into a coherent narrow column without visible horizontal overflow. Image, metric, table, and vertical process remain distinct. Chart annotations and table headers are the densest elements.
capture-2-mobile-scene-4.png: Evidence scene has strong contrast and an unclipped title. Chart values, quarter labels, and legend remain readable without visible collisions. Supporting copy and citation fit; the chart is noticeably smaller than the surrounding typography.
capture-2-mobile-scene-6.png: Process scene has clear vertical Draft → Compare → Review flow. Arrowheads stop before the next box, labels are centered, and title, body, and citation remain unclipped.
capture-2-scene-1.png: Chapter scene uses strong white-on-violet contrast, a dominant two-line heading, and a clean divider. Generous empty space creates an intentional opening pause; neither text column is clipped.
capture-2-scene-2.png: Photographic scene balances a large image with a readable heading and supporting copy. Image description fits underneath; text and artwork do not overlap. Wide separation creates a calm editorial rhythm.
capture-2-scene-3.png: Collage scene gives the metric and serif heading distinct emphasis. Dark text contrasts well with cream, supporting copy and citation fit, and no elements collide. The large lower whitespace sustains the spacious pacing.
capture-2-scene-4.png: Evidence scene clearly separates title, chart, legend, and explanation. Series colors contrast against black, values remain distinguishable, and no labels visibly overlap. Citation and bottom copy stay within the image.
capture-2-scene-5.png: Comparison scene has clean table alignment, readable headers, adequate row spacing, and no clipping. It is the weakest page because the tradeoff headline promises more differentiation than the nearly identical columns provide.
capture-2-scene-6.png: Process scene has readable text, clear boxes, and ample whitespace. Desktop connectors travel beneath the boxes and point upward into destinations, making the left-to-right sequence less immediate than the mobile version.

issues.reason: In capture-2-scene-5.png, only Revision differs; Exact value and Sources repeat. The table provides limited support for the headline's promise of tradeoffs, weakening the story before its close.
issues.suggestion: Frame this page around preserved evidence across revisions, or supply meaningful, supported differences that explain the choices.

issues.reason: In capture-2-scene-6.png, staggered connectors leave box bottoms, run underneath adjacent nodes, and point upward. Their proximity makes a simple three-step sequence slower to trace.
issues.suggestion: Route each connector directly from the right edge of its source to the left edge of its destination, keeping arrowheads in the gaps.
